content: PS1 shader gotchas (pixelwolf 2026 + three.js RetroPassNode + community libs): snap projected NDC (divide clip.xy by w, quantize to virtual-res grid, multiply w back) - snapping raw clip coords warps with camera distance. Never substitute random noise for quantization (shimmer when stationary). Snapping vertex positions breaks per-vertex lighting continuity - use flat shading or compute normals post-snap; combine with low internal res, nearest filtering, ordered dithering for coherent look; keep snapping off for UI/text geometry. three.js now ships RetroPassNode (TSL) doing snap+affine+low-res; simpler to use than hand-writing.
